title: Chapter 96: Another Turbulence
content:
Chapter 96: Another Turbulence

By the afternoon, the number of transporters on the transport avenue exceeded 150,000, and the territories of the alliance also sent their territorial troops to help with the transportation.

Everyone understood that there were many variables with the threat of the Tengu clan, so the more supplies they transported, the more money they could make.

Even Wu Qing couldn't figure out the Tengu clan's intentions, and it was very likely that they would fight a battle in the same camp with the Tengu clan.

The Tengu clan still had a very deep foundation, and as the non-combat personnel of various clans continued to arrive from the rear, the battlefield cleaning work continued to accelerate.

[I hope readers will remember our domain name Taiwan Novel Network →𝘵𝘸𝘬𝘢𝘯.𝘤𝘰𝘮]

Depending on the progress, the entire battlefield can be cleaned up before dark, and there is no need to worry about the battlefield tonight.

There is strength in numbers, and some high-level Tengu clan members have begun to think about the evil god camp camps and garrison territories occupied by the Tengu clan.

There are also many supplies left by the evil god camp army in these places.

The elder Gou Hong of the Tengu clan basically doesn't care about anything. The people below are calculating their own little thoughts, and they don't seem to care about the development of this branch of the Endless Mountains.

In a luxurious mansion in the Tengu clan camp, the senior member of the Tengu clan who once refuted Gou Yin's suggestion and said that he sent the alliance army to die was talking to the young man of the Tengu clan who played the role of the ambassador.

"Gou Zheng, you have dealt with the independent territory alliance and the Zerg in person. What is your impression of them?"

"Uncle, I just went to play for a while. Those people in the independent territory alliance are more barbaric, and those Zerg armies look a little scary!"

Gou Zheng was a little scared when he learned about the performance of the independent territory alliance and the Zerg on the battlefield. He didn't dare to add fuel to the fire and stir up trouble. He answered the questions honestly.

"Based on your feeling, do you think they dare to go to war with our Tengu tribe?"

"They probably don't dare. Although they have some strength, they are definitely not comparable to our Tengu tribe!"

Gou Zheng's pride as a member of the Tengu tribe was involuntarily revealed.

Then the high-ranking officials of the Tengu tribe looked at Gou Zheng's expression seriously, which made Gou Zheng feel a little uncomfortable, and then said: "Well, I have a task for you. If you complete it well, I will find a way to let you return to the tribe in advance!"

"Really? Can you really return to the tribe in advance?!"

Hearing that he could return to the tribe in advance, Gou Zheng jumped up excitedly.

"Don't get excited yet! If you can't complete the task, you can only endure it slowly!"

"I will definitely complete the task well!"

Gou Zheng patted his chest to promise.

"It's good to have confidence. Wait a minute, I will dispatch a direct army to you, and you can use my token to mobilize the subordinate territorial army to take back the city occupied by the Zerg for me!"

"What Gou Yin couldn't do, you did it. I will make a move, and you can go back early!"

"Remember! This is you taking my token privately, wanting to make a contribution. Uncle doesn't know about this, understand?"

When Gou Zheng heard about this task, he wanted to retreat, but he just patted his chest to promise, it was not easy to go back on his word at this time, plus the strong temptation to return to the tribe in advance, so he had to bite the bullet and agree.

As a direct descendant of the Tengu tribe, he was still confident in his own safety. As long as his life was safe, other things were insignificant in his eyes.

Thinking of this, his confidence was restored, and the dandy temperament of the child of a noble race was restored a little.

"Uncle, I understand!"

Although Gou Zheng was a dandy who did not do his job properly, he was not stupid, but very smart. He understood many things under the influence of his ears and eyes.

He took the token on the table and went out. There were two thousand elite Tengu cavalrymen waiting for him outside. The leader was the cold and arrogant Tengu general who had left Wu Qing and his men alone for a night and sent them to die.

Gou Zheng did not show any courtesy to the cold and arrogant general. He rode on the mount brought by his personal guards and shouted, "Let's go and gather people!" and set off first.

Gou Zheng led the Tengu cavalrymen to the rest area of the armies of various territories after the war. He took out the token and shouted, "All those who can fight, come out! Follow me to carry out the mission!"

The major lords came upon hearing the news. When they saw Gou Zheng, they all frowned. They didn't want to deal with this playboy of the Tengu clan.

However, Gou Zheng had the Tengu clan's troop mobilization token in his hand. They could only follow his orders and regroup the army that had rested for some time, ready to follow Gou Zheng to carry out the mission.

Holding tokens, all the lords who were attached to the Tengu clan followed orders, which made Gou Zheng feel high-spirited and regained the sense of superiority as a direct descendant of the Tengu clan.

With the army in hand, his mind changed unconsciously.

With a sharp blade in hand, the killing intention arises!

He thought of the grievances he suffered in the Independent Territory Alliance. Everyone ignored him and forced him to lead the way like a duck. He had never encountered such an experience, which left him with a psychological shadow.

Looking at the army in front of him, Gou Zheng decided that even if it was to vent his anger, he would do this task well.

Gou Zheng led the army to go out, and the Zerg responsible for monitoring immediately passed the news to Wu Qing.

"Meng, you go to gather the elite of the alliance, and we will go to meet the Tengu clan together!"

Through the Zerg’s vision, Wu Qing saw that the Tengu tribe had directly mobilized nearly 100,000 troops and marched towards the city occupied by the Zerg.

“Finally discovered our movements? Haha, I will gather the troops and see what they are going to do!”

Meng, Yu Chong and Bai Yan went to mobilize 5,000 elite soldiers of the alliance. They were representatives of the alliance, and the Zerg could not be the only ones to appear in such an occasion.

Nearly 60,000 Zerg troops in the city began to gather and prepare for possible changes.

Other high-ranking officials of the Tengu tribe also discovered the unusual movements of the armies of various territories, but the elder Gou Hong had not appeared yet, so they could not figure out the situation.

“What’s going on? Why are the armies of those territories dispatched? Who gave the order?”

Gou Yin couldn’t help asking.

Everyone looked at each other, not knowing who gave the order, and tacitly kept silent.

Gou Yin’s breath was blocked in his chest, and his face turned red.

…

The lords who were attached to the Tengu clan felt something was wrong when they saw that the direction of the army was actually the city where the Zerg army was stationed.

The army was marching, and the lords could not gather together to discuss, but they were all unwilling to be enemies with the Zerg at this time.

The performance of the Zerg on the battlefield was witnessed by everyone. Without the Zerg, they would have fallen on the battlefield today.

In addition to the selfless rescue of the Zerg last night and the protection of a night, even the cold-blooded people did not want to turn against the Zerg at this time.

Not only the lords thought so, but their soldiers also had the same idea.

These soldiers could not see the overall situation on the battlefield, but the life-saving grace of the Zerg last night was truly seen by everyone.

The Tengu clan was indifferent to their life and death, and it was the Zerg who rushed over without hesitation and saved everyone's lives!
